rule: flag if min side < min_side; std < std; p95 < p95_dark; p5 > p5_bright; sharpness < sharpness (all on a 256x256 gray version, as in Phase 3)

chosen_by.min_side: smallest side keeping accuracy >= 97% on degraded validation images, floor 64px
chosen_by.std: half of the lowest contrast (std) of any valid tomato training image

history.reason: the 0.5% budget rule flagged 14 valid validation leaves as 'blank'; replaced by half the lowest contrast seen in any valid training image
